name: Devs Accounting – Simple Accounting and Invoicing Solution
author: Devsbrain

sections.description:
This plugin allows you to manage your business accounting on your WordPress admin dashboard. You can add items and manage inventory, crate income and expense, can create invoice for your customers and track your acccounts. It also provides automatic reports.

DEVS ACCOUNTING FEATURES

Easy-to-Use Dashboard: Manage your entire accounting system from a clean and intuitive dashboard.
Automated Reports: Track your financial reports of Profit, Revenue, Expense and Daily Report effortlessly.
Invoice & Billing: Create and send invoices in seconds.
Income & Expense Tracking: Categorize and monitor cash flow.
Inventory Management: Keep track of products and stock levels.
Bank & Cash Account Management: Stay in control of all transactions.
Contact Management: Organize your customers, vendors, and partners efficiently.
Category Management: Classify transactions, items, and accounts for better reporting.
Accounts Management: Handle multiple accounts with smooth transfers and reconciliations.
Item Management: Manage products or services with pricing, tax, and stock details.
Import & Export: Easily import or export contacts, categories, transactions, and items in bulk for faster setup and backup.

EXTRA FEATURES FOR PREMIUM

WooCommerce Product Syncing: Users can sync their WooCommerce products, inventory, and pricing with DevsAccounting for seamless eCommerce management.
WooCommerce Order Syncing: Sync WooCommerce orders with DevsAccounting to track sales, payments, and customer details in real time.
Custom Pages for User Management: Dedicated pages for login, registration, user profile, and purchase history for a seamless user experience.
Secure Payment Gateway Integration: Support for PayPal, Stripe, Paddle, and other gateways to ensure smooth and secure transactions.

Try the Demo | Premium version | Documents

Privacy

This plugin does not connect to any third-party applications. But you can connect paypal for taking payment . It does not collect or store any user information.

Feedback

Any suggestions or feedback are welcome, thank you for using or trying my plugin. Please let me know about your experience and rate this plugin.

GET PRO VERSION

Need Any Help?

  • Please mail us at contact@devsbrain.com
  • We provide live support

Usage

  1. Go to Devs Accounting You can see dashboard.
  2. In settings page you can set your company info, payment method, custom pages, taxes, categories etc.
  3. Go to add category to add category for Item, Income and Expense separately.
  4. In items you can add items or products with price, category and photos.
  5. In transactions you can add income and expense for separate category.
  6. To add an invoice you need to go to invoices and click add.
  7. You can see profit, revenue, expense and daily reports reports in reports section.

Requirements

  • WordPress 4.6 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher

License

Support

If you need any assistance or have any questions about the plugin, please open a support ticket and we will be happy to help.

Contribution

If you want to contribute to the development of the plugin, you can submit a pull request on the plugin’s Github repository.
sections.installation:
1. Login to your WordPress admin dashboard.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Click on the “Upload Plugin” button.
  4. Choose the plugin zip file and click on the “Install Now” button.
  5. Activate the plugin and check it in the settings link.
sections.faq:
Can I manage invoices with this plugin?

Yes! The Pro version allows you to create, send, and track invoices.

Does this plugin support multiple currencies?

Yes! the Pro version lets you handle transactions in multiple currencies.

Can I get my business accounting summary?

Yes! You can easily track sales, income & expenses directly from your WordPress dashboard. You can view your total income, expense, and profit summary. You can also see category-wise income/expense pie charts and day-wise sales charts. It helps you observe your business performance clearly.

Can I manage Inventory & Stock?

Yes! You can easily add, edit, and delete items with purchase price, sale price, stock limits & expiry dates, and automatically update stock when creating invoices or bills.

Can I manage Bank & Cash Account?

Yes! You can easily manage multiple bank accounts and track cash flow in real time, and view balance updates instantly when income or expenses are recorded.

Can I manage billing?

Yes! You can easily manage and generate professional bills in seconds.

Can I view Financial Reports?

Yes! You can easily manage and get instant insights with income vs. expense, profit reports, and daily financial summaries, view category-wise income & expenses in easy-to-read charts.

With this plugin can I take payment?

Yes! The Pro version lets you take payment from your client through card, Paypal and Stripe.

Can I set tax rules for my products or services?

Absolutely. You can create and assign different tax rates by country and state when adding or editing items with the Pro version of Devs Accounting.

Does DevsAccounting work with WooCommerce?

Yes! The Pro version can detect and list WooCommerce products when adding items or invoices, making it easy to integrate with your existing store.
